common.tagline: All your links, strung together in one place — in every language.

home.heroTitle: One link in bio. Every language in the world.
home.heroSubtitle: Linketto is the multilingual “link in bio” page: your profile speaks every visitor’s language. Hosted in the EU, no commissions and honest prices.
home.featureLangBody: One page, many languages: visitors see your profile in their own language, automatically.
home.featureFeeBody: You sell through your own payment link (Revolut, PayPal and others) — the money goes straight to you, Linketto takes no cut. Your payment provider’s own fees still apply.
home.featureAnalyticsBody: We count clicks, not people. No personal data and no consent banner.
home.featureTrustBody: Transparent moderation with notice and the right to appeal. Never a shameful banner on your page.
home.featureEuBody: Hosted in the EU. Email (Brevo) and payments (Revolut Bank UAB) are with EU providers; Revolut may transfer data outside the EEA under its own policy. We send data outside the EU only to Google (Gemini, US) — your profile text for “Translate with AI”, “Generate bio” and the automatic translation for visitors (on by default, turned off with one button); we send no visitor data. Details in the Privacy Policy.
home.featureDomainBody: Custom domains on paid plans — your reputation never depends on someone else's abuse.
home.featureAiBody: Write in your language — Linketto translates your profile into all the others with one button.
home.featureQrBody: A QR code in your color and a vCard block that saves your contact to any phone with one tap.
home.heroBadge: Multilingual link in bio · EU hosted
home.manifestoQuote: We will never show “BANNED” to your visitors. We moderate transparently — with notice, a human response and the right to appeal. The reputation you build stays yours.
home.manifestoBy: A promise from the Carbon Stealth team
home.ctaTitle: Speak to the whole world from one link.
home.faq1a: Linketto is a link in bio page: one link that gathers all your links, products and contacts. The unique part: your page speaks every visitor’s language — build it once and it shows in all 24 official EU languages.
home.faq2q: How is Linketto different from Linktree?
home.faq2a: Four things: your profile has versions in every language and shows each visitor their own automatically; it is hosted in the EU and GDPR-compliant; analytics are cookie-free with no personal data; and you get your own domain from the Pro plan (€4/mo). A detailed comparison with sources and date is on the “Linketto vs Linktree” page.
home.faq3a: The free plan is truly free — unlimited links and 2 language versions. Pro is €4/month (all languages, custom domain), Business is €9/month (up to 5 profiles), and Founder is a one-off €49 — Pro forever, up to 5 profiles. You pay once for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months — no subscription and no automatic charges.
home.faq4q: How does the multilingual profile work?
home.faq4a: Visitors automatically see your profile in their language (from their browser settings) or pick one on the page. You write in your language and the built-in AI translation fills in the rest with one click — your manual translations are never overwritten.
home.faq5q: Can I sell products from my page?
home.faq5a: Yes — you add a product with a price and your own payment link (Revolut, PayPal, Gumroad and others). The buyer pays you directly; Linketto does not stand between you and takes no commission. You are the seller and are responsible for the order, taxes and the buyer’s rights.
home.claimAvailable: {slug} is available — claim it before someone else does.
home.claimInvalid: Letters, numbers and hyphens only (up to 32 characters).
home.trustPayments: Plan payments via Revolut Bank UAB (a licensed EU bank)

legal.privacyBody:
Controller: Carbon Stealth VCC, Company ID (EIK) 208725180, VAT No. BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu.

In short: we collect only what the service needs; we never sell data; we use no advertising or tracking technologies; profile visitors receive no cookies; we keep data in the EU. Plan payments are processed by Revolut Bank UAB (Lithuania, EU) under its own policy, which allows transfers outside the EEA; other data leaves the EU only to Google (Gemini) — on your explicit action (AI translation and bio generation) and for the automatic translation of your profile for visitors in other languages (on by default), which you can turn off from your dashboard.

What we process and why · Account: email, hashed password, chosen language — to run the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, contract). Profile content: names, descriptions, links, images — published by you. Contact-form messages: name, email, text — delivered to the profile owner (Art. 6(1)(f), legitimate interest — communication you requested); kept for up to 12 months. Booking requests ("Booking" block): name, email, preferred time, message — delivered to the profile owner on the same basis; kept for up to 12 months. Plan payments: plan, period, amount, VAT, the Revolut order identifier, status (incl. a payment refunded in full) and the card and billing-address countries Revolut returns to us — to provide and suspend the plan (Art. 6(1)(b)), for VAT and accounting (Art. 6(1)(c) — the place of supply and the threshold under Art. 20b of the Bulgarian VAT Act) and to protect against abuse and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(f)); your card details never reach us, and your account email is passed to Revolut for the payment. Reminder before a paid period ends: an email 7 days and 1 day before (Art. 6(1)(b)). Referral programme: bonuses and withdrawal requests with the account you specified (IBAN/PayPal/Revolut) — to pay out bonuses (Art. 6(1)(b)), to protect against abuse and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(f)) and for accounting (Art. 6(1)(c)); kept while the account exists + 30 days, and accounting records as required by law. Invitations: if you sign up via an invite, we record who invited you — to run the programme for them and to prevent abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)); they see only the number of sign-ups and payments from their invites, not who you are. Analytics: cookie-free, no IPs, no personal data — we only count views and clicks (Art. 6(1)(f)). Country from IP: to show the site and profiles in the visitor's language and to count visits by country, the IP address is looked up at the moment of the request in a local database (DB-IP) in our server's memory — it is not stored and not passed on to anyone (Art. 6(1)(f)). Weekly report: if you have a published profile, at most once a week we email you a summary — number of visits and your visitors' languages, with no personal data about them — based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) in keeping you informed about how your page performs; you can object at any time (Art. 21) — with one button from the link in any report or from your dashboard; the objection is honoured unconditionally. Import from Linktree: only on your action and only for your own public page, we fetch its public content (links, titles, bio, avatar) and add it to your profile (Art. 6(1)(b)); the avatar is re-encoded and EXIF data is removed. The free QR code generator runs entirely in your browser — nothing is sent to us. Withdrawal: if you withdraw from a paid plan, we keep your statement — name, the order, the date and time of receipt and when the acknowledgement was sent — together with the payment records, to process the withdrawal and be able to prove it (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f)). Notices and moderation (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065): we keep notices about profiles, our warnings and decisions, the category of breach and the reasons sent to the owner — to comply with the regulation and to defend appeals and legal claims (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f)); we keep them while the profile exists. Custom domain: the domain, a verification token and the verification date; we check the public TXT record in DNS (Art. 6(1)(b)). Clicks on products and links: counted without cookies, IP addresses or user agents — only with country, language and the site the visitor came from.

Sign-in security · When you sign in to your account we record the device's IP address and keep it for 90 days (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse protection). This never applies to profile visitors. Security log: to protect accounts from unauthorised access, we record events such as sign-ins and failed sign-in attempts, changes to 2FA, the password and sessions, email address confirmation and administrator actions — with the type and time of the event, the account and the country determined from the IP address (the IP address itself is not stored in the log). For a failed sign-in we do not store the email, only a keyed hash of it (HMAC) — this lets us recognise repeated attempts against the same address without keeping the address itself. We keep the events for 90 days, including after the account is deleted (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interest in the security of the service and the accounts); you can object (Art. 21). If you turn on two-factor authentication (2FA), we keep the key for the codes in encrypted form and hashes of the backup codes for as long as you use it — turning it off deletes them immediately (Art. 6(1)(b) — a feature you turn on yourself). When your account's security settings change (password, 2FA, backup codes, sign-out from devices), we send you an email notification (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)). Sign-in session: we keep only a hash of the token, the time it was created and the last activity; the session expires after 7 days without activity (for an admin account — 12 hours) and at the latest after 30 days (for an admin account — 24 hours), after which the record is deleted.

Recipients and transfers · Revolut Bank UAB (Lithuania, EU) processes plan payments as a payment service provider — for the payment itself, fraud checks and anti-money-laundering measures as an independent controller under its own policy (revolut.com/legal/privacy). The card details, name and address you enter on Revolut’s page are collected by Revolut — only the data listed above reaches us. Revolut may share data within its group and with the card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), including outside the EEA, under the safeguards in its policy. Google (Gemini API): when you press "Translate with AI" or "Generate bio" yourself (including in the free bio tool without sign-up), we send the name, description or notes you entered. For the automatic translation for visitors in other languages, we send your profile's public content (name, description, block titles and product titles) and the target language. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — making your profile understandable to visitors who speak other languages; the content is already public, and no visitor data is sent. The feature is on by default (for profiles created before it — only after an email notice); you can object at any time (Art. 21) with the "Turn off" button in your dashboard — then nothing more is sent and the stored translations are deleted immediately. For all Gemini features, Google LLC acts as a processor under Art. 28 GDPR, does not use what is sent to train models and keeps it for a limited time only to prevent abuse; the data may be processed outside the EEA, mainly in the US. The transfer relies on Google LLC's certification under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework (Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1795); the bio tool stores nothing on our side, and for its rate limit the IP address is kept only in server memory for up to 1 hour (Art. 6(1)(f), abuse prevention). Email: Sendinblue SAS (Brevo, France, EU) sends all transactional and newsletter emails on our behalf — solely to deliver them, as a processor under Art. 28 GDPR. An EU hosting provider. Beyond those — nobody. We never sell data or use it for advertising.

Retention · Account: while it exists + 30 days (if there are plan payments, the account is anonymised and the payment records are kept for 10 years). Contact-form messages and booking requests: 12 months. Newsletter subscribers: until unsubscribe — unsubscribing deletes the email; unconfirmed sign-ups: 30 days. Plan payment records: 10 years (accounting law). Analytics events: up to 13 months. Security log: 90 days (also after the account is deleted). Sign-in sessions: up to 30 days (for an admin account — up to 24 hours). Automatic profile translations: until you change the content, turn the feature off or delete the profile.

Your rights · Access, rectification, erasure, restriction (Art. 18), portability, objection (Art. 21) and withdrawal of consent at any time (Art. 7(3)) — write to info@carbonstealth.eu. You may lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (CPDP, www.cpdp.bg) or your local supervisory authority.

Automated decisions · When a plan payment is refunded in full, what it bought is removed automatically (the plan and period from before the payment are restored) and the referral programme bonus for that payment is reversed automatically. When a prepaid period ends without being extended, the account moves to the free plan automatically. These decisions are necessary for the performance of the contract (Art. 22(2)(a) GDPR). You can obtain human intervention on our part, express your point of view and contest the decision at info@carbonstealth.eu. We do not apply any other automated decisions.

Cookies · We use only strictly necessary cookies — __Host-linketto_session (httpOnly, to sign in to your account, up to 30 days; for an admin account — up to 24 hours), __Host-linketto_mfa (httpOnly, only between the password and the 2FA code, up to 5 minutes) and NEXT_LOCALE (only when you choose a language yourself, up to 12 months). Details in the Cookie policy.

Newsletter · If you subscribe to a creator's newsletter, we process your email and language on the basis of your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) with double opt-in; the content is the creator's (the creator is the controller, Linketto the processor under Art. 28). We keep the data until you unsubscribe (every email has an unsubscribe link). All transactional and newsletter emails (confirmations, email address confirmation messages and account security notifications, reminders before a paid period ends, newsletters, weekly reports) are sent via Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, EU).

Changes · We will notify you at your account email about material changes.
legal.termsBody:
Linketto is a service of Carbon Stealth VCC (Company ID (EIK) 208725180, VAT No. BG208725180, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu).

Content and moderation · Illegal content, impersonation, phishing, malicious links, spam and misleading information are prohibited. Anyone can report a profile via the "Report" link on every public profile or at info@carbonstealth.eu (point of contact under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 — DSA). We handle reports diligently and without arbitrariness. For a minor breach (e.g. spam) you first receive a warning with 7 days to fix it; for grave abuse (phishing, impersonation, illegal content) we may suspend the profile immediately. For every measure you receive by email, and see in your dashboard, a statement of reasons — what is restricted, for how long, why and on what ground — and you can appeal free of charge at info@carbonstealth.eu (appeals are reviewed by a human), complain to the Digital Services Coordinator or seek redress in court. We never show "BANNED" to your visitors.

Plans and payments · Paid plans are paid in advance, once, for a chosen period — 1, 3, 6 or 12 months — via Revolut (Revolut Bank UAB). There is no subscription and no automatic charge: we remind you by email 7 days and 1 day before the period ends, and if you do not extend, the account moves to the free plan and the paid features (custom domain, hidden badge, extra profiles and languages) stop. Extending the same plan is added to the end of the current period; when you move to a higher plan, the remaining days carry over pro rata by price. The Founder plan is a one-time payment with no payment end date — it applies for as long as Linketto is provided as a service; if we discontinue the service, we will notify you at least 90 days in advance. Prices are final, including 20% VAT. After every payment we send you a confirmation by email.

Right of withdrawal · If you are a consumer, you may withdraw from the contract for a paid plan (including an extension, a higher plan and Founder) within 14 days starting from the day after the payment (the conclusion of the contract), without giving any reason. When ordering, you expressly request that the plan start immediately after payment (a tick box before the payment button). If you requested to begin the performance of the service during the withdrawal period, on withdrawal you shall pay us an amount which is in proportion to what has been provided until the moment you inform us of your withdrawal from the contract, in comparison with the full coverage of the contract. We calculate it by time: the amount paid, multiplied by the time from the start of performance under that payment until we receive your withdrawal, and divided by the whole period of that payment (1, 3, 6 or 12 calendar months; for Founder — 365 days). We round to the cent in your favour. If the payment extends your current plan, performance under it begins at the end of the current period — if you withdraw before then, we refund the full amount. We refund the rest to you. If you did not expressly request an early start, we refund the full amount. Once the contract has been fully performed, the right of withdrawal no longer applies. Withdrawal removes only what that payment bought — the plan and period you had before it are restored; if you moved to a higher plan, the previous plan's period is extended by the time you used the new one. Withdraw with the “Withdraw from contract here” button in your dashboard (section “Plan”) or send us a clear statement at info@carbonstealth.eu — you may use the form below, but you do not have to; after withdrawing in the dashboard you immediately receive a confirmation by email; the deadline is met if you send your statement before it expires. We refund without undue delay and no later than 14 days from the day we receive your notice, using the same means of payment, at no cost to you.

Model withdrawal form — To: Carbon Stealth VCC, 3 Samuil St, 2670 Bobov Dol, Bulgaria, info@carbonstealth.eu. I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the provision of the following service: … / Ordered on: … / Name: … / Address: … / Account email: … / Signature (only if on paper) / Date: …

Refunded or disputed payment · If a plan payment is refunded in full, only what that payment bought is removed — the plan and period you had before it are restored (the free plan, if that earlier period has already ended). If you dispute a payment through your bank (chargeback), we may suspend the plan granted by it until the dispute is resolved.

Referral programme · Every account has a personal invite link; on profiles showing the “Create your free page” badge (mandatory on the free plan) it carries the profile owner's link. For the first payment for a paid plan made by a person who signed up through your link, you receive a bonus of {percent}% of the amount paid. The bonus is held for 30 days after the payment (the period for withdrawal and disputes) and only then is added to your balance available for withdrawal. No bonus is due for a payment from which the invited person has withdrawn from the contract, which has been refunded in full or in part, or which has been disputed through the bank (if the dispute is resolved in our favour, we decide separately). If this happens after the bonus is already in your balance, it is reversed, even if it has already been withdrawn; your balance may then become negative and the difference is deducted only from future bonuses — we do not require you to pay it to us separately, and it is waived when the account is closed. Withdrawal is possible once your balance reaches €{minPayout}. You are responsible for declaring the bonus as income. No bonus is due for sign-ups made by you or for fake accounts. If we suspect this, we review it manually, tell you the reasons, and you may object at info@carbonstealth.eu. An annulled bonus is deducted in the same way as a reversed bonus above.

Products · You can show products on your profile with a price and your own payment link (e.g. Revolut, PayPal, Gumroad). Linketto does not sell, accept payments, deliver or take a commission: the purchase contract, payment, delivery, taxes and the buyer’s rights (incl. the 14-day right of withdrawal where it applies) are entirely between you and the buyer. Next to each product we show whether you are a trader or a private individual — by your own declaration, so the buyer knows whether consumer rights apply; if you are a trader, you owe buyers the information and rights under consumer protection law. The price you enter must match the final price on your payment page (incl. VAT and all fees); if you are a trader, price reductions must follow the prior-price rules. You must not offer illegal goods or services or link to fraudulent payment pages.

Automatic translation · For visitors in languages you have no translation of your own for, your profile (name, description, block titles and product titles) is shown machine-translated by Google Gemini, labelled “Machine translation (AI)” with a link to the original. The feature is on by default and you can turn it off at any time from your dashboard. By publishing content, you allow us to translate and display it for this purpose. Machine translation may contain inaccuracies — for important texts add your own translation, which always takes precedence; product descriptions are not machine-translated.

Changes to the service · We may change the features of the service for a valid reason (e.g. new features, security, legal requirements) at no additional cost to you. For a change that affects your data or the way your content is displayed, we notify you in advance by email; if the change negatively affects your access to or use of the service, you may terminate the contract free of charge.

Import · You import only your own content. By ticking “This is my page” you confirm that the page is yours and that you hold the rights to its content.

Liability · You are responsible for the content you publish and the products you offer. We are not liable for the content of external sites your links lead to.

Legal guarantee and disputes · As a consumer you have the statutory rights if the digital service is not in conformity (Directive (EU) 2019/770 and the Bulgarian law transposing it). For out-of-court dispute resolution you may turn to the Conciliation Commission for Consumer Disputes at the Bulgarian Commission for Consumer Protection (www.kzp.bg).

Governing law · Bulgarian law; Bulgarian courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights in your country.
legal.cookiesBody:
Linketto uses only strictly necessary cookies: __Host-linketto_session (httpOnly — to sign in to your account, up to 30 days; for an admin account — up to 24 hours), __Host-linketto_mfa (httpOnly — only between the password and the two-factor authentication code, up to 5 minutes) and NEXT_LOCALE — set only when you choose a language from the menu yourself (a setting you explicitly request), keeping your choice for up to 12 months. If you signed in before the sign-in cookie was renamed, the old sign-in cookie linketto_session may also be read and deleted at your next sign-in. They do not track your behaviour and are never shared.

Visitors of public profiles receive no cookies at all. Our analytics are cookie-free: we count views and clicks without IP addresses, without user agents and without any personal data.

Because we use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, no consent banner is required (strictly necessary cookies — Art. 5(3) Directive 2002/58/EC; Art. 4a(4)(2) Bulgarian E-Commerce Act). Plan payments take place on Revolut’s page, which sets its own cookies under its own policy.

Questions: info@carbonstealth.eu.
